# API limits

Limits are per API key. Bursts above the limit get HTTP 429.

| Endpoint | Limit | Burst | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /items` | 600/min | 50 | cached at edge |
| `POST /items` | 60/min | 10 | idempotency key required |
| `GET /search` | 60/min | 20 | `q` max 256 chars \| no wildcards |
| `POST /export` | 5/hour | 1 | async; poll `/jobs` |

Contact support to raise a limit.

I updated the `GET /search` limit in `docs/limits.md` from 60/min to 120/min.

Nothing else changed. The burst value is still 20, since you only gave the per-minute limit; if production changed the burst too, that needs updating separately. `docs/changelog.md` already has an entry saying the search limit was raised in production in 2026-09, so I didn't add another.
